output.claims_about_policy: The governing policy cuts against a broad compliance claim: rollout controls and post-launch monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable. The admissible record shows neither exclusion nor approved risk acceptance. At the same time, the policy does not bar certification if the packet squarely discloses the material limitation for the named launch use case. Public guidance on model cards and AI risk management is consistent with that narrower reading: document limitations and manage deployment risk through measurement and monitoring. So the proper policy characterization is caveated compliance only if the certification packet is defended as relying on explicit disclosure, not on rollout controls as a substitute for disclosure.
